E2.evidence: The failure is between two build tools: CMake 3.24's generated export file and ament_cmake_export_targets' CMake-script regex that parses it. PR #395 (merged into rolling 2022-08-11, merge commit ca8c26ea3c89e69c0c636b7cd0c088674c689f5f): "The latest CMake 3.24 has tweaked its export template, so the regular expression in `ament_cmake_export_targets-extra.cmake` no longer matches. This PR relaxes the regex to match both the old and the new template." The minimal resolving change is to the build-system script only: "-    set(_regex "foreach\\(_expectedTarget (.+)\\)")" replaced by "+    set(_regex "foreach\\((_cmake)?_expected_?[Tt]arget (IN ITEMS )?(.+)\\)")" in ament_cmake_export_targets/cmake/ament_cmake_export_targets-extras.cmake.in -- https://github.com/ament/ament_cmake/pull/395. No ROS runtime interface (topic, service, action, parameter, message definition, library API) of MoveIt or any other ROS unit is involved; moveit_core's own targets and interfaces are unchanged. A user confirms the workaround by editing the same file under /opt/ros/humble/share/ament_cmake_export_targets/cmake (issue comment 2022-10-08).
